@@ -0,0 +1,29 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+depends_on:
+- 01M3ETSEG8QR1Y31J1FB1A2YQB
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8780'
+title: Make the unit test target build and pass against the work-queue Router
+---
+## What
+After the pin moves, `swift build --build-tests` fails in `Tests/FoundationModelsMultitoolTests`. Known breaks, measured by the board review:
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsMultitoolTests/Fixtures/StubRouterFixtures.swift`: `LoadedLLMContainer` now requires `var tokenCounter: any TokenCounter`, with no default (`../FoundationModelsRouter/Sources/FoundationModelsRouter/Resolution/ModelLoader.swift:127`). The Router has no public implementation of it. Add a stub `TokenCounter` that implements `count(_: String)`, `count(_: Transcript)` and `prefix(of:tokens:)` (for example, one token for each 4 UTF-8 bytes), and give it to `StubLLMContainer`. Also, `RepoMetadata` now throws `metadataUnavailable` when `config.json` has no `max_position_embeddings`, `n_positions`, `max_seq_len` or `seq_length`. Add `"max_position_embeddings": 32768` to the `StubMetadata` config.
+- [ ] Renames in the tests: in `RegistrySwapTests.swift` and `SurfaceRefresherTests.swift`, replace `turnWillBegin()` with `submissionWillBegin()`. In `MCPSessionSweepTests.swift:36`, replace `cancelCurrentTurn` with `cancel()`. In `SuspendedContextTests.swift:56`, replace `.synchronousUnbounded` with `.synchronous`. In `HardeningTests.swift:23` and `RunBindingTests.swift:30`, use `MultiToolConfiguration.defaultExecutionTimeLimit`. In `SearchToolsToolTests.swift:341` and `WaitToolTests.swift:276`, update the comments.
+- [ ] `SandboxGlobalsTests.swift:332-341` and `RouterSessionMountTests.swift:122` use the removed `ToolContext.terminalDetailTailLimit`. Temporarily assert against a named local constant and add a `// See the detail-bound task` comment. The detail-bound task replaces them.
+- [ ] `submissionWillBegin()` now also runs between continuation submissions of one answer (compaction yield, rejected tool call, repetition recovery). So a staged registry can be applied in the middle of an answer. Add a test for this.
+- [ ] Fix each other compile error that `swift build --build-tests` reports. Record the list in a task comment.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] `swift build --build-tests` passes with no errors and no new warnings.
+- [ ] `swift test` passes.
+- [ ] `rg -w 'turnWillBegin|TurnBoundaryTool|cancelCurrentTurn|synchronousUnbounded|defaultTimeoutSeconds|deadlineSecondsCeiling' Tests` returns no match.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsMultitoolTests/StubRouterFixturesTests.swift` (new): `makeStubProfile()` resolves, and `makeStubSession()` answers one prompt.
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsMultitoolTests/RegistrySwapTests.swift`: stage a registry that removes a verb, call `submissionWillBegin()` between two calls of one answer, and check that a later `runCode` call to the removed verb gives a repairable tool error (the unknown-verb hint), not a crash.
+- [ ] Run `swift build --build-tests && swift test`. Expected result: all tests pass.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd`. Write failing tests first, then do the implementation that makes them pass.
\ No newline at end of file
